title: Not easy to use
text: Not easy to use. You would think there would be a setting on the dial that says something like "hot dogs" and "burgers" or "steaks" or something.. Anything.. an icon even... I was purely guessing on what temperature to cook anything, so I tried hot dogs and burned the hell out of them.  It's kind of a pain to remember to add water to the little plastic tray too, I almost forgot the one day. I honestly don't use this much, I've only tried it twice now. Food ended up in the trash because it was burned to a blackened crisp. Will have to do some research to figure out what temperature to cook foods on so I don't burn again. And I"m leaving a sticky note on this thing to remember to fill up the water tray. Who knows what would happen if you don't do that, but better to be safe.
